verdict.rationale: Mixpanel offers AI-generated insights via natural-language querying through its hosted MCP server and AI summaries/trend-spotting across session replays and heatmaps, giving AI-native users in-product suggestions. However, these are narrower than a native in-dashboard 'AI insights' assistant — the MCP capability requires connecting an external AI assistant client rather than being a built-in insight generator, and evidence of proactive suggestions (vs. reactive query answering) is limited. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality, evidence of native automated anomaly/insight surfacing without MCP setup, and detail on how broadly 'suggestions' extend beyond replay/heatmap summaries.
